tools.name: search_pubmed
tools.description: Search PubMed for biomedical literature. Returns article summaries with PMIDs, titles, authors, journals, and DOIs.

articleType.description: Article type filter (e.g., review, clinical trial)

tools.name: search_europepmc
tools.description: Search Europe PMC — a broader biomedical corpus than PubMed that also indexes preprints (bioRxiv, medRxiv), patents, and agricultural/biomedical databases. Unlike search_pubmed, each result includes an abstract snippet, citation count, open-access status, and whether a preprint. Use preprintsOnly to surface work ahead of formal publication.

query.description: Search query (Europe PMC query syntax supported, e.g. field tags like AUTH, TITLE, JOURNAL)

sort.description: Sort order: relevance, date (newest first), or cited (most cited first)

tools.name: get_abstract
tools.description: Get the full structured abstract and metadata for a PubMed article. Returns abstract sections (background, methods, results, conclusions), keywords, MeSH terms, and PMC ID.

tools.name: get_full_text
tools.description: Get the full text of an open-access article from PubMed Central. Returns article sections, figure/table captions, and reference count. Only works for articles available in PMC.

tools.name: find_related
tools.description: Find related articles for a given PubMed article. Returns similar papers ranked by relevance score using PubMed's neighbor algorithm.

pmid.description: PubMed ID to find related articles for

tools.name: format_citation
tools.description: Format a citation for a PubMed article in APA, Vancouver, Harvard, or BibTeX style.

tools.name: trending_papers
tools.description: Find recent/trending papers on a topic. Sorted by date, with optional filtering to high-impact journals.

days.description: Number of days to look back

tools.name: get_uspi
tools.description: Get FDA US Prescribing Information (USPI) for a drug from openFDA (cited to DailyMed). Returns structured labelling sections with LOINC codes, verbatim. Long sections are paged: a cut section has truncated: true, total_chars and next_offset — call again with that section and offset to read on. Check drug_name: the best openFDA match may be a different product from the one you meant.

sections.description: Specific sections to retrieve (e.g., ['indications', 'adverse reactions', 'contraindications']). Returns all sections if omitted.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters returned per section (default 6000). Long sections are returned a page at a time: a cut page has truncated: true, total_chars and next_offset.

offset.description: Character offset to start each section from (default 0). To read the rest of a truncated section, call again with sections set to that one section and offset set to its next_offset.

tools.name: get_smpc
tools.description: Get UK/EU Summary of Product Characteristics (SmPC) for a drug from eMC (medicines.org.uk). Returns structured labelling sections, verbatim. Long sections are paged: a cut section has truncated: true, total_chars and next_offset — call again with that section and offset to read on. Check drug_name: the best eMC match may be a different product or formulation from the one you meant.

sections.description: Specific sections to retrieve — accepts numbers like '4.1' or names like 'indications'. Returns all sections if omitted.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters returned per section (default 6000). Long sections are returned a page at a time: a cut page has truncated: true, total_chars and next_offset.

offset.description: Character offset to start each section from (default 0). To read the rest of a truncated section, call again with sections set to that one section and offset set to its next_offset.

tools.name: compare_labels
tools.description: Compare US FDA Prescribing Information vs UK/EU SmPC for a drug side-by-side. Maps equivalent sections (e.g., US Indications ↔ UK 4.1) and returns paired verbatim content. A missing side is always explained: us_label/uk_label say whether the label was retrieved, each comparison notes why a section is null, and sections longer than max_chars are flagged truncated with next_offset (read on with get_uspi / get_smpc).

drug.description: Drug name to compare across US and UK labelling

us_drug.description: Name to use for the US lookup when it differs from `drug` (e.g. a US-only brand). Defaults to `drug`.

uk_drug.description: Name to use for the UK lookup when it differs from `drug` — brands often do (Farxiga/Forxiga, Prilosec/Losec). Defaults to `drug`.

sections.description: Specific topics to compare (e.g., ['indications', 'adverse reactions']). Compares all mapped sections if omitted.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters per side per section (default 4000). Longer sections are cut and flagged truncated with total_chars and next_offset; read on with get_uspi / get_smpc.

tools.name: search_by_indication
tools.description: Find drugs approved for a medical condition. Searches US FDA labelling for the condition, then checks UK (eMC) availability for each drug found.

condition.description: Medical condition or indication to search for (e.g., 'type 2 diabetes', 'hypertension')

maxResults.description: Maximum number of drug results to return

tools.name: resolve_drug_name
tools.description: Convert a brand drug name to its generic name (or a generic to its US brand names), with drug class and common indications. Deterministic — sourced from RxNorm/openFDA, no AI.

drug.description: Brand or generic drug name to resolve (e.g., 'Lipitor' or 'atorvastatin')

tools.name: search_trials
tools.description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov for clinical trials. Filter by condition, intervention, status, and phase. Returns trial summaries with NCT IDs, status, sponsors, and enrollment info.

tools.name: get_trial
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific clinical trial from ClinicalTrials.gov. Returns eligibility criteria, study design, arms, outcomes, locations, and associated PubMed IDs.
